## 1. Risk Assessment Matrix

| ID | Risk | Category | P | I | Score | Action | Mitigation |
|----|------|----------|---|---|-------|--------|------------|
| R-001 | Auth token injection/bypass | SEC | 2 | 3 | 6 | MITIGATE | E2E tests for redirect on unauthenticated access |
| R-002 | Role-based access control bypass | SEC | 2 | 3 | 6 | MITIGATE | Verify role checks on project create, bug status change |
| R-003 | Bug creation with invalid data accepted | DATA | 2 | 2 | 4 | MONITOR | Form validation E2E tests for required fields |
| R-004 | Status transition to invalid state | BUS | 2 | 2 | 4 | MONITOR | Status workflow E2E tests |
| R-005 | Comment XSS via markdown injection | SEC | 2 | 3 | 6 | MITIGATE | Markdown rendering safety tests |
| R-006 | Sprint date validation bypass | DATA | 1 | 2 | 2 | DOCUMENT | Basic form validation tests |
| R-007 | Kanban board doesn't reflect status changes | BUS | 2 | 2 | 4 | MONITOR | Board refresh / consistency tests |
| R-008 | Mobile responsive layout breaks | TECH | 2 | 1 | 2 | DOCUMENT | Responsive viewport tests |
| R-009 | Dark/light mode persistence failure | TECH | 1 | 1 | 1 | DOCUMENT | Theme toggle persistence tests |
| R-010 | Activity log missing entries | DATA | 2 | 2 | 4 | MONITOR | Verify activity entries after actions |

## 5. Execution Strategy

- **PR Gate**: All P0 + P1 E2E tests (~28 tests, <15 min target)
- **Nightly**: Full regression including P2 tests
- **Weekly**: P3 + exploratory tests

Test execution via:
```bash
# P0 smoke
npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep '@p0'

# P0 + P1
npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep '@p0|@p1'

# Full regression
npx playwright test --project=chromium
```
